Cheapest JFK option, but the supplier is hidden. Midsize sedan is the easiest NYC choice: cheaper, easier to park/garage, enough for two people with moderate luggage, but not roomy if bags are heavy. Use it only if price matters more than knowing the counter experience before booking.

Car + NYC tradeoff: Midsize sedan is the easiest NYC choice: cheaper, easier to park/garage, enough for two people with moderate luggage, but not roomy if bags are heavy. NYC reality: driving into Manhattan can be slow, toll-heavy, and stressful; parking/garages can be expensive and tight. A rental only makes sense if they need out-of-Manhattan flexibility, luggage control, or day trips—otherwise taxi/subway/rideshare may be easier.

Review summary: no company-specific JFK confidence because the counter is unknown; choose only if the savings justify that uncertainty.
